changelog:
- Initial release of EmailAgent with AI-powered email composition and sending
- Integrated human-in-the-loop middleware for approval, editing, or rejection of outgoing emails
- Supports configuration of OpenAI model via environment variable (default: gpt-4o-mini)
- Allows email composition customization with optional subject, body, and instructions fields
- Read-only email operations proceed without interruption or approval
summary: Compose and send emails using AI with human approval for sending, allowing edits or rejection before delivery.
